questions.question: Review the English wordplay: Krugloyed is retained as the creature’s name, glossed as round-eater, and its sound resemblance to Russian krugloye d is explained in Notes. Decide whether an independent English pun would work better.

localizations.source: Review the English wordplay: Krugloyed is retained as the creature’s name, glossed as round-eater, and its sound resemblance to Russian krugloye d is explained in Notes. Decide whether an independent English pun would work better.
localizations.ru: Проверить английскую адаптацию «круглоеда»: выдуманное имя оставлено как Krugloyed, раскрыто через round-eater, а созвучие krugloye d объяснено в EN-примечании. Решить, нужен ли более самостоятельный английский каламбур.

questions.resolution: The Krugloyed adaptation is accepted: the name is retained, while round-eater and the resemblance to krugloye d are explained in Notes without inventing an English homonym.

questions.question: The text closely follows S. N. Fedin’s anecdote «Круглоед», yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation and illustration work.

localizations.source: The text closely follows S. N. Fedin’s anecdote «Круглоед», yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation and illustration work.
localizations.ru: Текст близко следует анекдоту «Круглоед» С. Н. Федина, но авторство и корневой rights_basis целиком отданы Мансуру Гильмуллину. Нужно развести авторство исходного текста и вклад Мансура — адаптацию и иллюстрацию.

questions.question: The actual cover contains only the Russian text “Это КРУГЛОЕД!” and “КРУГЛОЕД”. The English edition needs a localized cover or an explicit editorial decision to retain the Russian one.

questions.question: The label “author’s illustration” and the entry “Mansur Gilmullin’s archive” establish file custody, but do not identify the image creator, rightsholder, public source, or licence. Before publication, provide those details or remove the unsupported authorship claim.
